# NoodleController

> Renders SVG noodle connections between DOM elements within a host container.

## Constructor

```ts
new NoodleController(host: HTMLElement, options?: NoodleOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | no | CSS selector for elements that can be connection endpoints (default: '[data-noodle-port]') |
| `editable` | `boolean` | no | Allow interactive creation/deletion of connections (default: false) |
| `color` | `string` | no | Noodle stroke color (default: 'var(--n-color-accent-500)') |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | no | Noodle stroke width in px (default: 2) |
| `tension` | `number` | no | Bezier curve tension — how far control points extend (default: 0.5) |
| `showPorts` | `boolean` | no | Show port indicator dots on connectable elements (default: true when editable) |
| `portSize` | `number` | no | Port indicator dot size in px (default: 10) |
| `connections` | `NoodleConnection[]` | no | Initial connections (default: []) |
| `style` | `'bezier' | 'step' | 'straight'` | no | Noodle curve style (default: 'bezier') |
| `animated` | `boolean` | no | Animate noodles with a flowing dash pattern (default: false) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disable the controller |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:noodle-connect` | `{ id, from, to, fromPort, toPort }` |
| `native:noodle-disconnect` | `{ id, from, to, fromPort, toPort }` |
| `native:noodle-drag` | `{ from, fromPort, x, y }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |
| `connect()` | `from: string, to: string, fromPort: PortSide = 'right', toPort: PortSide = 'left'` | `string` |
| `disconnect()` | `id: string` | `boolean` |
| `clear()` | `—` | `void` |
| `getConnections()` | `—` | `NoodleConnection[]` |
| `setConnections()` | `connections: NoodleConnection[]` | `void` |
| `update()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { NoodleController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new NoodleController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
